issues.display_title: Issue #30: [Feature] Chat Analytics & Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) Tracking in CockroachDB
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Implement persistent chat analytics and query frequency tracking in CockroachDB for gothru-rag.

This capability allows GoThru to capture chat interaction metrics and automatically aggregate user questions into a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) / Popular Queries scoreboard. The aggregated statistics will help identify recurring user inquiries, evaluate feature demand, and highlight knowledge gaps in documentation.

Technical Design & Database Schema

1. Database Schema (app/db/connection.py)

Add two new relational tables to init_db:

  1. chat_query_logs (Per-message interaction logs):

    • id: STRING PRIMARY KEY (UUID)
    • session_id: STRING NULL
    • raw_query: STRING NOT NULL (Sanitized user prompt)
    • normalized_query: STRING NOT NULL (Lowercased, trimmed, punctuation-stripped query for grouping)
    • intent: STRING NULL (Intent classification from Copilot Planner, e.g. how_to, execute_action, greeting)
    • feature: STRING NULL (Resolved feature name from Route Registry or action contract, e.g. Edit 360 Images)
    • has_client_action: BOOL DEFAULT FALSE (Whether the response triggered a client action)
    • action_target: STRING NULL (Target modal/route if an action was provided)
    • created_at: TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
    • Indexes: idx_chat_logs_normalized, idx_chat_logs_created_at, idx_chat_logs_feature

  2. chat_query_stats (Aggregated question frequency scoreboard):

    • query_hash: STRING PRIMARY KEY (Deterministic SHA-256 or MD5 hash of the normalized query)
    • normalized_query: STRING UNIQUE NOT NULL
    • sample_question: STRING NOT NULL (Representative original query text)
    • category_feature: STRING NULL
    • ask_count: INT DEFAULT 1
    • last_asked_at: TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
    • created_at: TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
    • Indexes: idx_query_stats_ask_count_desc (ask_count DESC)

2. Data Access Layer (app/db/repository.py)

Extend CockroachRepository with analytics queries:

  • record_chat_interaction(...):
    • Insert record into chat_query_logs.
    • Atomic upsert into chat_query_stats: 
      INSERT INTO chat_query_stats (query_hash, normalized_query, sample_question, category_feature, ask_count, last_asked_at)
VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, 1, clock_timestamp())
ON CONFLICT (normalized_query) DO UPDATE SET
    ask_count = chat_query_stats.ask_count + 1,
    last_asked_at = clock_timestamp();
  • get_popular_questions(limit: int = 20, feature: str | None = None):
    • Retrieve the most frequent queries sorted by ask_count DESC.
  • get_chat_overview_stats(days: int = 30):
    • Calculate total queries, distinct questions, client action conversion rate, and feature volume breakdown.

3. Non-Blocking Asynchronous Ingestion (app/api/routes_chat.py)

  • Database logging must not increase chat response latency or fail user queries if the database is temporarily unreachable.
  • Use FastAPI BackgroundTasks to asynchronously record interaction logs and update counters after streaming/composing the response.

4. Admin Analytics API Endpoints (app/api/routes_admin.py)

Add endpoints protected by the X-Admin-Key header:

  • GET /stats/popular-questions:
    • Query parameters: limit (default: 20), feature (optional).
    • Response: List of top questions, frequency counts (ask_count), and last_asked_at timestamps.
  • GET /stats/overview:
    • Query parameters: days (default: 30).
    • Response: Aggregate metrics (total chats, unique questions, action trigger rates).

5. Privacy & Data Hygiene

  • Sanitize prompt inputs prior to persistence: strip authentication tokens, API keys, email patterns, and excessive white spaces.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Tables chat_query_logs and chat_query_stats are automatically created on startup/migration (init_db).
  • Calling /chat records interaction logs and increments query frequency counters asynchronously in the background.
  • GET /stats/popular-questions returns the top queried questions ordered by frequency.
  • GET /stats/overview returns volume aggregates and intent/feature distributions.
  • Database repository and analytics endpoints have unit and integration test coverage.

API Result Specification & Endpoints

1. GET /stats/overview

Retrieves aggregated copilot usage metrics and distributions within a given lookback period.

  • Method: GET
  • Path: /stats/overview
  • Headers:
    • X-Admin-Key: <ADMIN_API_KEY> (Required)
  • Query Parameters:
    • days (integer, optional, default: 30, min: 1, max: 365): Lookback period in days.

Example Request:

curl -X GET "http://localhost:8000/stats/overview?days=30" \
  -H "X-Admin-Key: your-admin-api-key"

Response 200 (application/json) — ChatOverviewStatsResponse:

{
  "period_days": 30,
  "total_queries": 2,
  "unique_questions": 2,
  "action_triggers_count": 0,
  "action_conversion_rate": 0.0,
  "feature_distribution": [
    {
      "feature": "Billing & Plans",
      "count": 1,
      "percentage": 50.0
    },
    {
      "feature": "General",
      "count": 1,
      "percentage": 50.0
    }
  ],
  "intent_distribution": [
    {
      "intent": "how_to",
      "count": 2,
      "percentage": 100.0
    }
  ]
}

2. GET /stats/popular-questions

Retrieves frequently asked questions ranked by ask count with non-null category resolution.

  • Method: GET
  • Path: /stats/popular-questions
  • Headers:
    • X-Admin-Key: <ADMIN_API_KEY> (Required)
  • Query Parameters:
    • limit (integer, optional, default: 20, min: 1, max: 100): Maximum number of questions to return.
    • feature (string, optional, default: null): Filter by specific GoThru feature category.

Example Request:

curl -X GET "http://localhost:8000/stats/popular-questions?limit=10" \
  -H "X-Admin-Key: your-admin-api-key"

Response 200 (application/json) — PopularQuestionsResponse:

{
  "total": 2,
  "items": [
    {
      "query_hash": "5f92b090d24a5a3387a08dd237b06b96483c7040ef9d18d4d3c2fb6469598f9c",

    {
